name: Opal
tagline: Build and share AI mini-apps from a plain-language description.
description: Opal is an experimental Google Labs tool for building AI mini-apps without code. You describe a task in natural language and Opal generates a workflow that chains prompts, models, and tools, which you can refine in a visual node editor and share with others via a link. It targets marketers, analysts, and other non-engineers who want to prototype and ship small AI-powered tools quickly.
insight: Launched July 2025 as a US-only public beta, then expanded to 15+ more countries.
edge: Turn a plain-language description into a shareable, visual mini-app that chains prompts, models, and tools — no code, hosted by Google.
pros: Visual node editor to refine logic
Share finished apps via a link
cons: Not aimed at complex production apps

references.title: Google debuts no-code Opal tool for building 'AI mini apps'
